Amit Shah Inspects Indigenous Border Security Technology in West Bengal

Amit Shah, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader, has visited West Bengal to inspect indigenous border security technology. This is his first visit to the state since the Suvendu Adhikari government took charge. The trip aims to review security arrangements and unveil a big-ticket project in Amul.
